en:
*sigh*
How troublesome...
Kirumi? Is something wrong?

You are about to hear me complain.
I would fail you as a maid.

No, that's not true!
If that's what's bothering you...

Asking for help and solving problems faster
will help your master, too...won't it?
That is true...

But, I do not have a master to serve at the
moment... I am but a stray maid...
A "stray maid"!?

I used the phrase "stray maid" to help you
understand. It is similar to a stray cat or dog.

<CLT=cltMIND>First of all, I don't think those
things belong in the same category...
What should I do...?

Is being a stray maid
that much of a problem?
Yes, it is incredibly dishonorable.

<CLT=cltMIND>Kirumi is even more serious than when she
told me about her most fearful enemy...

Either my last master disposed of me,
or no person needs my assistance...
That is the same as having no existence...
<CLT=cltMIND>...Really? That bad?

Ah, Kirumi?
I have a proposal for you.

Even if it's just for a little while...why
don't I become your master?
If it's alright with you, of course.

If it is you, then I do not have any complaints.
But, you will have to pay me...

After you sign the contract,
I will serve as your maid.
Right...
About my salary...
The standard is $10,000 per day.
...What?
Isn't that way too expensive!?
You're definitely worth it
...Can I get a lower-quality rate?
Are you unsure of something?
Sometimes, I will charge you additional fees.
Isn't that way too expensive!?

Yes, I am aware that it is more expensive
than the usual market rate...

...but I promise my service is well worth it.
It will not be a waste of your money.

<CLT=cltMIND>The way she said that...
She's completely confident.

You're definitely worth it. It's honestly...
really expensive, though.

Of course.
The salary matches the quality of my service.
<CLT=cltMIND>Such confidence...

If I say my service is valuable,
then perhaps it will encourage you to hire me.

But it is also my duty to provide you a service
that will be worth your payment.
...Can I get a lower-quality rate?
What do you mean?

That's too expensive for me, can
I get a discount or something?

I am sorry, but...
I cannot lower the quality of my service.

If I did such a thing, that would be a losing
scenario for the both of us.
Ah.
Alright...I'll pay you.
Are you sure?

If I think about it as an investment
for my future, it's not so expensive.

And most importantly...
you get to keep your honor.

Kirumi?
Is something wrong?
Pft...!

<CLT=cltMIND>She's laughing!?
Kirumi...laughing!?
I was joking.
J-Joking!?

$10,000 a day is definitely too steep
of a price!
Also, I was kidding about the stray maid thing.

I didn't know you could
tell jokes, Kirumi.

Yes, such humor is needed from a maid
to calm their master.
For me, I would tell jokes to my master.
<CLT=cltMIND>To her master?

Shuichi... I have told you this before, but
I feel something within you.
I want to serve you regardless of the money.

As your personal maid...
Allow me to support your future.

Once we escape, will you give serious 
consideration to employing my services?
Kirumi...

<CLT=cltMIND>That wasn't a joke this time.
Kirumi's dead serious.

<CLT=cltMIND>Honestly, I feel like Kirumi would
be totally wasted on me, but...

<CLT=cltMIND>I want to see...the same potential
that Kirumi sees in me.
Yeah. I'll consider it, Kirumi.

You have my gratitude...
I hope it will be a wise choice.

<CLT=cltSYSTEM>Kirumi's <CLT=cltSTRONG>Report Card<CLT=cltSYSTEM> has been updated
based on your experience with her.

<CLT=cltSYSTEM>You've learned a new skill,
<CLT=cltSTRONG>Bed Making<CLT=cltSYSTEM>.

<CLT=cltMIND>Kirumi and I discussed my future,
and I returned to my room.
